name: tool-web-fetch-llm-routed
about: router 开启（tokenSaver 判档、subagent 策略缺省 judge、fallback、stats）时 web_fetch 的二次模型请求：它走 router.stream 且 isMainAgent:false（nativeAgentTurnCapabilitiesAdapter.ts:67-79），先被判档模型按网页提示判成 simple 档改发 bbx/cheap（max_tokens 被 cheap 的 4096 封顶），第二页 cheap 回 500 后按 fallback.default 改发 bbx/deterministic。比较判档请求、二次请求、router/stats.jsonl 与 events、会话记录。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        judge:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        cheap:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 4096
        big:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
router:
  enabled: true
  stats:
    enabled: true
    retentionMs: 86400000000
  fallback:
    default:
      - bbx/deterministic
  tokenSaver:
    enabled: true
    judge: bbx/judge
    defaultTier: complex
    cacheAwareSwitching:
      enabled: false
    tiers:
      simple:
        model: bbx/cheap
        label: Cheap tier
        description: quick answers
      complex:
        model: bbx/big
        label: Big tier

site/tls.json.note: test-only throwaway CA/leaf for 127.0.0.1; not a credential
